verdict.rationale: Pika's Language Swap app ("Same voice, new language") lets you upload a speaking clip and get translated speech with voice matching and lip sync, which covers every element of the story. The support is documented only in one-line vendor descriptions, so depth is unclear. Missing for 10: detailed docs on supported languages, length limits and multi-speaker or full-video handling, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of translation, voice and lip-sync quality.
